queries.referenceContract: Native Layout Service resolves these reference fields directly; these are inspectable Edge integration queries, not fabricated SDK field objects or unverified custom resolvers.
queries.productOptions: query ProductOptions($path: String!, $language: String!) { item(path: $path, language: $language) { id heading: field(name: "heading") { jsonValue } products: field(name: "products") { ... on MultilistField { targetIds targetItems { id label: field(name: "label") { jsonValue } productKey: field(name: "productKey") { jsonValue } image: field(name: "image") { jsonValue } quoteLink: field(name: "quoteLink") { jsonValue } } } } } }
queries.approvedAnswer: query ApprovedAnswer($path: String!, $language: String!) { item(path: $path, language: $language) { id version question: field(name: "question") { jsonValue } answer: field(name: "answer") { jsonValue } sourceLink: field(name: "sourceLink") { jsonValue } canonicalUrl: field(name: "canonicalUrl") { jsonValue } disclosure: field(name: "disclosure") { ... on LookupField { targetItem { id body: field(name: "body") { jsonValue } } } } } }
queries.publicationRule: Use the Live context for downstream APIs and Search projection. Preview is for native authoring. Draft content is never read from Preview and relabeled as approved.
